description: Regenerate package-lock.json via npm install on the OPEN_INTERNET environment, then get `npm run build` to pass cleanly. Also run and capture results of typecheck, lint, and test. Add a vercel.json SPA rewrite at repo root for React Router. Commit the regenerated lockfile, vercel.json, and any fixes locally on branch fix/deps-build-compat. This is a single coherent unit of work because the lockfile regeneration, build verification, and config addition are tightly coupled and all serve the one goal: a clean, verifiable, deployable build.
steps: Confirm internet: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://registry.npmjs.org/` returns 200 (already verified by orchestrator).

Run `npm install` in /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen. This regenerates package-lock.json. Capture the exact output (packages added, vulnerabilities, any ERESOLVE/peer-dep warnings or errors). If npm install fails on peer deps, document the exact error and resolve minimally without changing already-fixed major versions (vite ^7.1.9, vitest ^3.2.4, @vitejs/plugin-react ^5.0.4).

Run `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build). Capture full output. If it fails, read the specific error (TypeScript type error, vite config issue, missing export, etc.), fix the SOURCE of the error. DO NOT edit src/types/database.ts and DO NOT edit anything under supabase/migrations/. If a type error originates from database.ts usage, fix the consuming code instead. Repeat until build passes and dist/ is produced.
Run `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) and capture pass/fail + key errors.

Run `npm run lint` (eslint .) and capture pass/fail + key errors. If there are pre-existing lint failures unrelated to the dependency fix, document them honestly rather than making risky changes; fix only clearly safe/in-scope issues.
Run `npm run test` (vitest run) and capture pass/fail + summary (passed/failed/total).

Create /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen/vercel.json with an SPA rewrite so React Router client-side routes resolve: {"rewrites": [{"source": "/(.*)", "destination": "/index.html"}]}. Ensure valid JSON with trailing newline.

Stage and commit locally on branch fix/deps-build-compat: package-lock.json, vercel.json, and any source fixes. Use a clear conventional-commit message, e.g. 'chore(deps): regenerate lockfile and verify build; add vercel SPA rewrite'. DO NOT push. DO NOT create a new branch.
Write a concise per-command result report (npm install, build, typecheck, lint, test) into the feature's findings field.

src/types/database.ts is unchanged (git diff shows no modifications to it).

Run `git status` and confirm working tree is clean after commit (lockfile + vercel.json committed).

Deprecation warnings for whatwg-encoding and eslint 9.39.5 (informational). package-lock.json regenerated and committed. @supabase/supabase-js resolved to 2.117.3 (floats from ^2.45.0).

ROOT CAUSE OF BUILD FAILURE AND FIX:
The initial `npm run build` failed with ~80 TypeScript errors, almost all 'Property X does not exist on type never' / 'not assignable to parameter of type never' across every feature api.ts. Root cause: @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.3's postgrest-js resolves the typed client's Schema to `never` when the Database type's table/view `Row` members do not satisfy `Record<string, unknown>`. The generated src/types/database.ts declares each Row as a bare `interface`, and a bare interface has no implicit index signature, so it fails `extends Record<string, unknown>`; this collapses the whole GenericSchema to never. Verified empirically with type probes (homomorphic mapped type `{ [K in keyof T]: T[K] }` satisfies the constraint; the bare interface does not).

Fix WITHOUT touching the generated file (hard constraint): added src/types/supabase-compat.ts exporting `NormalizeDatabase<DB>`, a type-level deep rewrite that maps every table/view Row through `{ [K in keyof Row]: Row[K] }` (gaining the index signature). src/lib/supabase.ts now calls `createClient<NormalizeDatabase<Database>>(...)`. Purely a type transform; runtime shape unchanged. src/types/database.ts and supabase/migrations/ are UNCHANGED (verified: `git diff HEAD~1 -- src/types/database.ts supabase/migrations/` is empty).

Residual genuine errors (previously masked by the never-collapse), fixed at source:
- src/features/crud/api.ts: generic admin CRUD selects table at runtime; typed `table` as keyof Database['public']['Tables'] and confined the unavoidable dynamic-table cast to a single documented `CrudQueryClient` boundary (server is_admin RLS remains authority).
- src/features/courses/api.ts(248): the comment-join select returns a SelectQueryError because database.ts has empty `Relationships: []`; routed the result cast through `unknown` to match the existing pattern used by the sibling joins in the same function.
- vite.config.ts errors (node:url, import.meta.url): @types/node was missing. Added @types/node@^22 devDependency and `"types": ["node"]` to tsconfig.node.json.

ALSO: added `*.tsbuildinfo` to .gitignore (tsc -b incremental artifacts). Created vercel.json at repo root with the SPA rewrite {"rewrites":[{"source":"/(.*)","destination":"/index.html"}]}. Formatted changed files with prettier (project has prettier configured).
